verdict.rationale: Missive documents assigning conversations to a team or a specific person while keeping visibility (missive-docs-6), with shared and team inboxes (missive-docs-28, missive-docs-32) and an action log showing who did what (missive-docs-9). Its pricing page lists a rules engine of up to 1000 rules (missive-docs-25, missive-docs-36), and the changelog references rules creating drafts (missive-docs-45). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that rules can route or auto-assign incoming mail to owners, detail on rule conditions and actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of assignment and rules.
